system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform action: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication.. my mobile_number is 9876594529, my aadhaar_number is 100020004304.

function.name: midh_check_eligibility
function.description: Checks eligibility for MIDH horticulture subsidy based on land ownership, crop suitability, category (general/SC-ST/women/hilly region), and prior subsidy history. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has existing MIDH subsidy for same land (duplicate), land records unavailable, or crop-region mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: midh_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
